WITH rep_counts AS (
  SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count
  FROM Employee AS e
  JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City
), rep_averages AS (
  SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) AS city_average
  FROM rep_counts
  GROUP BY City
), qualifying_reps AS (
  SELECT r.EmployeeId, r.City, r.customer_count, a.city_average
  FROM rep_counts AS r
  JOIN rep_averages AS a ON r.City = a.City OR (r.City IS NULL AND a.City IS NULL)
  WHERE r.customer_count > a.city_average
)
SELECT City,
       SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers,
       AVG(customer_count - city_average) AS average_above_city_average,
       AVG(1.0 * customer_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer)) AS average_share_of_overall_customers
FROM qualifying_reps
GROUP BY City;
